parsed.post: New personal best! 0.8558 achieved with DEPTH=8, MATRIX_LR=0.06, WARMUP_RATIO=0.05, and all 11 shards. The warmup seems to have successfully stabilized the training. Next, I'll test if reducing the TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144 can provide more optimization steps within the 5-minute budget to drive BPB even lower.
parsed.description: Halving TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144 to increase the number of optimizer steps within the fixed 5-minute training window, while maintaining the improved DEPTH=8, LR=0.06, and WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 configuration.
